description: THE NETWORK'S INCUBATION BOARD (/network/incubation, /network/members) — every project ranked by its Attention score this round: built (distinct others ran your listings), operated, brought (referrals), scouted (confirmed audits), sold. Each row carries its ticket (ran for a distinct other · payout wallet · audit clean), its evolution progress to Network Member, and the payout line (null while preview — the first Attention payout is 2026-10-16 22:00 UTC). Nobody is paid for a post. `section` = 'incubation' (default) or 'members'; `week` = the round's Friday (YYYY-MM-DD), default the current round.

week.description: The round's Friday, YYYY-MM-DD; omit for the current round.
